what_it_is.prose: The P17A Nilgiri-class is a seven-ship stealth frigate class of the Indian Navy, under construction at Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited (MDL, Mumbai — 4 ships) and Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers (GRSE, Kolkata — 3 ships). Designed by the Indian Navy's Directorate of Naval Design, the P17A is a follow-on to the P17 Shivalik-class (3 ships commissioned 2010-2012). The class features enhanced stealth characteristics (radar cross-section, infrared, and acoustic signatures), a combined diesel and gas (CODAG) propulsion system using GE LM2500 gas turbines (USA) and diesel engines, and a comprehensive indigenous combat suite. The seven ships are: INS Nilgiri (first ship, commissioned 2025), INS Himgiri, INS Udaygiri, INS Dunagiri, INS Vindhyagiri, INS Taragiri, and INS Mahendragiri. The class displaces approximately 6,670 tonnes full load, is 149 m long with a 17.8 m beam, and achieves 28+ knots. Armament mirrors the P15B destroyers: LR-SAM (Barak-8) in 32 cells, BrahMos in 8 cells, 76mm Oto Melara SRGM (license-produced by BEL), RBU-6000 ASW rocket launchers, and 533mm torpedo tubes. Sensors include the EL/M-2248 MF-STAR radar (Israel) and BEL Humsa-NG hull-mounted sonar. The target indigenous content is approximately 75%.

faq.question: Where are the P17A Nilgiri-class frigates being built?
faq.answer: The seven P17A Nilgiri-class stealth frigates are being built at two Indian Navy shipyards: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited (MDL) in Mumbai is building four ships, and Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers (GRSE) in Kolkata is building three. The class is designed by the Indian Navy's Directorate of Naval Design and is a follow-on to the P17 Shivalik-class (3 ships commissioned 2010-2012).

faq.question: When will all seven P17A frigates be commissioned?
faq.answer: The first ship, INS Nilgiri, was commissioned in 2025. The remaining six ships are in advanced stages of construction or trials at MDL Mumbai and GRSE Kolkata, with deliveries expected through 2027-28. Exact commissioning dates for the remaining ships have not been publicly disclosed.

faq.question: What is the armament of the P17A class?
faq.answer: The P17A frigates carry the same armament suite as the P15B destroyers: LR-SAM (Barak-8) in 32 vertical launch cells for air defence, BrahMos supersonic cruise missiles in 8 cells for anti-ship and land-attack, a 76mm Oto Melara SRGM (license-produced by BEL) for surface fire, RBU-6000 anti-submarine rocket launchers, and 533mm torpedo tubes. The target indigenous content is approximately 75%.
